comparison.objective: Level and pin-lock a fallen platform before placing two loads on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and align a hinged platform, insert a pin through three holes, then place loads without contacting a mannequin hand.
comparison.success_condition: The pin must traverse both walls and lug, platform must be level, both blocks placed, arms clear, and any premature loading or hand contact fails.
comparison.reason: This tests safeguard restoration by multi-hole pin insertion before loading. The candidate instead tests a translating carriage whose internal balls require continuous rail-to-jig support.
